newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BALTIC BEVERAGE EYES UTENOS BEVERAGES-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: BALTIC BEVERAGE EYES UTENOS BEVERAGES-REPORT.

text.p: Finnish-Norwegian joint venture Baltic Beverages Holding (BBH) wants to buy 50 percent of one of Lithuania's leading brewers Utenos Beverages and has offered 300 litas per share, newspaper Verslo Zinios said on Wednesday.
The president of BBH, Henrik Therman, was quoted as saying his company would like to buy 50 percent or less in the company and thereby invest $20 million into Utenos Bewerages.
BBH is owned jointly by Finland's Hartwall and Pripps, part of Norway's Orkla .
"300 litas for a share (with face value of 100 litas) is a respectable price," Therman was quoted as saying.
BBH already owns most of another leading brewer Kalnapilis and if the company gets the 50 percent of Utenos it wants, it would control around 60 percent of the country's beer market.
Denmark's Carlsberg has already said it wants to buy a controlling stake in Utenos, which is not quoted on the stock exchange.
Because of a disagreement with the government, which owns 21 percent of the company's shares, Utenos has not yet succeeded in registering new shares with the securities commission.
The share capital of Utenos Bevrages is currently at 22 million litas.
